svg.title: ROADMAP speed targets
svg.desc: Target: Cold start to first page loaded < 700 ms, Umbra CLI: 408 (413) met, Umbra socket: n/a (CLI only); Target: One-shot read (no daemon), cold < 500 ms, Umbra CLI: 385 (391) met, Umbra socket: n/a (CLI only); Target: Warm navigate to a local page < 120 ms, Umbra CLI: 27 (28) met, Umbra socket: 13 (14) met; Target: Accessibility snapshot (orders table) < 25 ms, Umbra CLI: 14 (14) met, Umbra socket: 0.9 (1.3) met; Target: Click + DOM update (role=switch) < 40 ms, Umbra CLI: 15 (16) met, Umbra socket: 1.5 (3.4) met
